text:
Which statement about aqueous ethanoic acid is correct?
A
It reacts with metal carbonates to form salts, hydrogen and water.
B
It reacts with metal oxides to form salts and oxygen.
C
It reacts with reactive metals to form salts and hydrogen.
D
It turns damp red litmus paper blue.

options.label: A
options.text: It reacts with metal carbonates to form salts, hydrogen and water.

options.label: B
options.text: It reacts with metal oxides to form salts and oxygen.

options.label: C
options.text: It reacts with reactive metals to form salts and hydrogen.

options.label: D
options.text: It turns damp red litmus paper blue.
